packageRules.description: Track MyGo without bypassing the coupled native-source and provenance gates.
prBodyNotes: MyGo requires joint review of go.mod/go.sum, third_party/native-terminal/UPSTREAM.json, terminal source hashes, the hardening patch and all OS/library evidence. Version extraction does not approve or regenerate trust hashes. See docs/dependency-updates.md.

packageRules.description: Keep the Kubernetes API, clients, and streaming protocol modules on one reviewed version series.

dependencyDashboardHeader: Dependency updates require review and exact-head CI. MyGo module and native source versions are grouped; source hashes, terminal patches and libraries still require manual provenance review. An empty queue is not a vulnerability or release certificate.
